title: A screen's header: its title, one plain line of what matters now, and its actions on the right (the main one filled)
about: The top of a person's own screen: 'Your day', then a line of its few figures in words ('12 planned this week, 3 to act on'), and its main action ('Add a session') with a quieter one beside it. For a small personal app this line takes the place of big number cards.

sub.about: the line under it: words, or an =expression of the screen's data

open.about: with primary: the view it opens

call.about: with primary: a function it calls instead

secondary.about: a quieter action's words (may be an =expression, 'Archived (' + n + ')')

secondaryOpen.about: with secondary: the view it opens
